subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the privileged action-pin updates be accepted as one reviewed group after representative exact-head workflow proof, or should the Codex and credential-handling action updates be split for separate security review?
rationale: The patch is mechanically clean, but it changes third-party executable code at security-sensitive workflow boundaries owned by the security review team; repository intent is needed to accept the grouped blast radius.

options.title: Approve after targeted proof
options.body: Keep the grouped pin update and merge after security-owner review plus representative exact-head runs of the privileged workflow families.

options.title: Split privileged action updates
options.body: Separate Codex, app-token, Docker publishing, and CodeQL pins so each security-sensitive runtime delta can be approved and reverted independently.

recommendation.title: Approve after targeted proof
recommendation.body: Keep the grouped pin update and merge after security-owner review plus representative exact-head runs of the privileged workflow families.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository history connects this account most strongly to action-runtime modernization, CI maintenance, and the affected Codex agent workflow.
